scripts.postbuild: npm run migrate:verification-preview && npm run smoke:preview
scripts.migrate:verification-preview: if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "preview" ] && [ "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF" = "feat/automated-verification-pipeline" ]; then if [ -z "$SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" ]; then echo 'HUMN_VERIFICATION_MIGRATION_BLOCKED: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN is missing'; else cd ../.. && echo 'HUMN_LOCAL_MIGRATIONS_BEGIN' && find supabase/migrations -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\n' | sort | grep '^20260725' && echo 'HUMN_LOCAL_MIGRATION_HASHES' && sha256sum supabase/migrations/202607250018* 2>/dev/null || true; npx --yes supabase@latest link --project-ref bondfumehickzmmbfwoe && (npx --yes supabase@latest migration list --linked || true); fi; else echo 'HUMN_VERIFICATION_MIGRATION_SKIP: not target Preview'; fi
